name: agentic-vault
description: Shared Markdown memory, bounded session context, source-attributed recall and verified backups for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.31.0: vault_runs flips counts per-assertion pass-to-fail flips between compatible completed runs; an optional assertion role adds FULL/PARTIAL/NO grades without changing scores or decisions. Ledger check-support marks rows backed only by another ledger's fact table (the only default-output change); --primary-text-only counts them as unsupported and --normalize-periods compares period expressions as date intervals or abstains. vault_doctor --session-evidence reports from one named Claude Code transcript whether SessionStart hooks ran, failed or were truncated, without content. checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again. No model/network call, default hook/search change or automatic vault migration is added.
defaultPrompt: Use agentic-vault to restore this vault's session context.
Use agentic-vault to find the sources for our last deployment decision.
